Card Q&A.q: When this card is in the digivolution cards of a Digimon with an effect that adds colors, such as “This Digimon is also treated as red,” does this card’s inherited effect activate?

Effect: [Security] At the end of the battle, play this Digimon without paying its memory cost.
Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] If this Digimon has 2 or more colors, gain 2 memory.
